name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: Kael, Thorne, and Quarterstaff go with Druid, Paladin, and Wizard, in some order.
Paladin goes with exactly one of Orin, Greataxe, or Warhammer.
Either Lyra goes with Wizard, or Orin goes with Druid — but not both.
Quarterstaff does not go with Wizard if and only if Warhammer goes with Kael.
Exactly two of these are true: Lyra goes with Longsword; Orin goes with Crossbow; Barbarian goes with Greataxe.
Either Kael goes with Crossbow or Orin goes with Quarterstaff.

So Kael does not go with Barbarian.
